correctness.rationale: The normalized enriched nerve is specified cell-by-cell. The needed tree lemma is reconstructed from the established integral exact-length magnitude homology with explicit primitive d1 matrices, simply connectivity, and Whitehead. For girth>2L each tuple and each face lifts coherently to the graph universal cover; the quotient nerve is its true simplicial covering. A graph-plus-edge-sphere wedge map induces isomorphisms on pi1 and on all homology of universal covers, so Whitehead gives the claimed integral homotopy type. Alternating edge cycles establish the automorphism sign. The executable finite crosschecks verify integer d^2=0 and two-prime homology but are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: A uniform infinite family spanning every cyclic graph satisfying 2L<girth, with L>=3, has its complete integral homotopy type and signed edge automorphism representation determined. The result has a structural proof via a new coherent short-geodesic nerve covering, rather than being a textbook rank deduction or an arbitrary finite slice. The strict girth boundary is meaningful: C6 at L3, C8 at L4 and C10 at L5 have additional intermediate homology.
